morphology.formula: meN- + perlahankan → memperlahankan; dasar leksikal: perlahan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包保留直接基底 perlahankan；词汇基底为 perlahan。本词保留 p，不能机械套用普通 p 起首词的鼻音替换规则。DBP指出 memperlahankan 已约定俗成，不宜据此推广所有形容词的构词方式。[DBP构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempercepat+kan)

senses.zh_definition: 降低人、物体的移动速度，或减缓活动、过程的发展速度。
senses.en_definition: To reduce the speed of movement or the rate of an activity or process.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，通常带受影响的对象；既可指车辆减速，也可指过程放缓。不是单纯表示动作方式的 perlahan-lahan。释义依据[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=192692&keyword=perlahan)。

senses.zh_definition: 降低说话声或其他声音的响度；把音量调小。
senses.en_definition: To lower the volume of a voice or other sound.
senses.nuances: 这里减少的是响度，并不必然降低语速或音调高低。释义依据[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=192692&keyword=perlahan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pemandu hendaklah memperlahankan kenderaan apabila menghampiri kawasan sekolah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 驾驶员驶近学校区域时应减速。
dual_scenarios.en: Drivers must slow their vehicles down when approaching a school zone.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Perlahankan radio tu sikit, ya. Adik dah tidur.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tolong perlahankan bunyi radio itu sedikit kerana adik sudah tidur.
dual_scenarios.zh: 把收音机调小声一点哦，弟弟已经睡了。
dual_scenarios.en: Turn the radio down a little, please. My little brother's asleep.
spoken_features: 口语请求使用不带 meN- 的 perlahankan。
tu 对应 itu，sikit 对应 sedikit，dah 对应 sudah。

messages.speaker: Farah (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Perlahankan radio tu sikit, ya. Adik dah tidur.
messages.ms_standard: Tolong perlahankan bunyi radio itu sedikit kerana adik sudah tidur.
messages.zh: 把收音机调小声一点哦，弟弟已经睡了。
messages.en: Turn the radio down a little, please. Our little brother's asleep.

messages.speaker: Amir (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, dah perlahankan. Dengar perlahan je sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya sudah memperlahankan bunyi radio itu. Bunyinya perlahan sahaja sekarang.
messages.zh: 好，已经调小了，现在就一点点声音。
messages.en: Okay, I've turned it down. It's really quiet now.

etymology.historical_story: This established derivative brings together two everyday meanings of perlahan: moving slowly and sounding softly. DBP records both, while its language advice notes that memperlahankan became conventional through widespread use despite a stricter morphological preference for memperlahan. Its history illustrates how accepted usage can preserve a form that a simple productive rule would not predict. [DBP language advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mempercepat+kan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 perlahan：车速往下、音量往下；加上使动结构，就是“把它降下来”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请他人降低音量时，用 Tolong perlahankan suara sedikit, ya 比直接命令更柔和；对长辈或陌生人尤其适合。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于交通提醒、工作说明和音量请求。评价他人说话太响时，宜提出具体请求，避免当众斥责。频率排名沿用输入包，未另行验证其统计来源。
